13:
The sequence $(a_n)$ is given by $a_n=\frac{5n+6}{10(n+1)}$ for every natural number $n\ge1$.
a) Examine the monotonicity of the sequence $(a_n)$.
b) Calculate $\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n$.
c) Give the greatest number a and the smallest number b such that the condition $a\le a_n\le b$ holds for every n.
15: Students commuting to school observed that the bus being late depends on which of three drivers is driving. Statistical research showed that when driver A drives, the bus is late on 5% of trips, when driver B drives on 20% of trips, and when driver C drives on 50% of trips. During a 5-day school week, driver A drives twice, driver B drives twice, and driver C drives once. Calculate the probability that the school bus is late on a randomly chosen school day.
16: Objects A and B lie on two sides of a lake. Field measurements of the relevant angles were made: [Figure: triangle ABC with angle ABC = 130 deg at B and angle ACB = 30 deg at C]. The distance between objects B and C equals 400 m. Calculate the straight-line distance between objects A and B, rounding the result to the nearest meter.
17:
An isosceles trapezoid $ABCD$ with longer base $AB$ and shorter base $CD$ is circumscribed about a circle of radius $r$. The point of tangency $S$ divides the leg $BC$ so that $\frac{|CS|}{|SB|}=\frac{2}{5}$.
a) Find the length of the leg of this trapezoid.
b) Calculate $\cos\angle CBD$.
18: Among all regular triangular prisms with volume equal to $2\,\text{m}^3$, there is one whose total surface area is smallest. Determine the edge lengths of this prism.
